prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1356; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was backing out of a parking space at a shopping center in Sugar Land, Texas, moving slowly, when the other vehicle came around the end of the row and struck the rear passenger side of my car. I stopped immediately, stayed at the scene, and exchanged information with the other driver. Afterward I noticed a stiff, sore neck, which I have since been treating as a neck strain. I have told the same version of events each time I have described the collision. When I later remembered a few more small details, such as the position of the other car's headlights, I added them, but the core sequence stayed the same. I am the named driver on this policy and I was the one operating my vehicle at the time of the accident.
